All per-element/per-recipient getters close over one shared c.c2Buff slice. Every getter zeroes every slot, sets its captured element slot=.5, and returns that same slice. Reactions or Burning-compatible enemy damage invoke the writer only while white or black burst is active; each adds 6s mods. Getter calls can overwrite data observed by other active mods; exact enumeration/evaluation order is not proved by static source.
The multi-slot local vector is captured by its AttackMod; preserve exact amount and attack-tag gate in the excerpt. No field update loop is evidenced by this local construction.

One mutable c.burstBuff is captured by every party-member stat mod. Amount returns nil unless burst active and the recipient is current active character. ATK is updated from a periodic 0.3s task, source-guarded; when burst expires it explicitly writes ATK=0 then stops. Value is min(non-extra ATK * points-dependent rate, talent-level cap); periodic scheduling and gates are material.

CR=.05/CD=.40 are initialized once only when C6 and moonsign level>=2; distribution requires same owner gates, then only recipients with moonsign>=1 get 20s modifier. No write/update after initialization appears in this trace.
